services.name: Harbor Sails
services.desc: Choose your Fall Youth Sailing program and complete registration below through The WaterFront Center's secure Amilia registration system. Description: Set sail for an awesome adventure! Kids will learn to sail on our Opti boats, mastering skills such as rigging, steering upwind and downwind, staying safe on the water, and performing capsize drills. They’ll also discover sailing lingo and sportsmanship while making new friends and having a blast! Perfect for beginners, this class lets kids learn at their own pace and repeat as needed to become confident sailors. services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Step aboard IDA MAY, a stunning replica of the historic 1925 oyster dredge that worked Oyster Bay’s waters for 75 years. Faithfully recreated to honor its legacy, this iconic vessel measures 50 feet long and 17 feet wide, with a wide, open deck designed to carry up to 40 passengers-perfect for private fishing charters, group outings, or simply soaking in the beauty of the Long Island Sound. Built to modern U.S. Coast Guard safety standards, IDA MAY ensures a secure and comfortable experience while its classic design celebrates Oyster Bay’s rich maritime heritage and the artistry of traditional wooden boat building.
